# L&B Exterior Cleaning

> Professional exterior cleaning services across the Mornington Peninsula, Victoria, Australia.

## Services
- Gutter cleaning and downpipe clearing
- Solar panel cleaning and restoration
- Window cleaning (inside and out; flyscreens on request)
- Pressure washing (driveways, patios, pool surrounds)
- Façade cleaning (render, brick, painted surfaces, cladding)

## Service Area
Frankston and the Mornington Peninsula including: Mornington, Mount Martha, Rosebud, Rye, Sorrento, Portsea, Frankston, Langwarrin, Carrum Downs, Mount Eliza, Cranbourne, Somerville, Hastings, Flinders, Blairgowrie, Safety Beach, Dromana, Red Hill, Tyabb, Bittern, Moorooduc, Balnarring, Shoreham
